title: Local font equals the inherited font
description: Layout-quality rule — an object sets a font locally that it would get from its style or theme anyway. FileMaker writes such a setting when bold is applied to a font with its own bold face (the family is stored with the bold PostScript name). The setting changes nothing today, but it pins the font: a later theme change no longer reaches the object.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A local font that repeats the inherited one is invisible until the theme changes — then this object keeps the old font while its neighbours follow.
rule.remediation: Clear the local font setting of the object (keep bold through the style or the font weight).
